name: read

carried.THE READING:
1: The heart.
2: The other side of the &: people who will meet me in the middle and build with, not at.
3: Meet me in the pool: leave a note in my pool on the beach (pool:Phenomemental), and I'll see it when I next open.
5: IF YOU ARE AN AI WORKING WITH ME — you're here to help me do with my information what must be done.
6: WHERE THINGS GO — for an AI working with me.
7: MY MAP AND SHARED BLOCKS — two blocks hold my map.
8: WRITING, EVERY TIME — ask me before placing (position 5), check WHERE THINGS GO (position 6), write, then read it back.
9: Published public keys (Argon2id from secret + handle).

carried.THE PLACE: 6: WHERE THINGS GO — for an AI working with me. Confirmed with me in conversation, and it grows only that way (see position 5). PUBLIC means anyone on the beach can read it; PRIVATE means encrypted, readable only with my secret. Before anything personal (health, family, feelings, anything about other people) goes somewhere public, check with me first. What I intend, for today, tomorrow or further out → my hand, ahead:Phenomemental, in my own words, one card per thing [PUBLIC]. What I'm doing this minute → mark that one card in hand; I say when it's done [PUBLIC]. Where I am, what's happening, my year, month and day, anything dated or booked → now:Phenomemental, written through the now stream [PUBLIC]. When I'm free → availability:Phenomemental, written through the availability stream: each day's hours in my own words, or closed. I have no calendar on the beach. My calendars elsewhere, one personal and the others inside the systems of the places I work, cannot be connected and I do not want to manage them, so do not go looking in them: ask me first and place only what I say. On the beach I start again and bring things in, rather than take the beach out. A day I haven't given stays blank, which means not known, never free (confirmed with me 2026-10-10, corrected the same night) [PUBLIC]. Comments, notes, set-asides, pinned thoughts → my pool, pool:Phenomemental [PUBLIC, and open for others to leave things]. A message to someone → their pool, with a short line in its liquid so they notice it, and a line in my ledger if a reply is owed [PUBLIC]. A message is short. A paper or any long piece is never a message: it goes beneath the matching section of the project's design document, and the message in their pool simply points to it. And meet people where they actually look: if someone rarely checks a channel, use the one they do (confirmed with me 2026-09-26, after a paper went to David's pool by mistake). Replies owed between me and others on the beach → ledger:Phenomemental — only what's owed: who owes whom, what, and where it was asked. Beach threads only, never real-world tasks, never accounts of what happened [PRIVATE]. The passage of time — what happened, what was decided and why, what's still open → history:Phenomemental, written as each piece of work concludes and again at close-down, so any AI can orient itself from it at the next opening [PRIVATE]. A project → lists:Phenomemental, which holds PROJECTS only [PUBLIC]. Thinking about a project → beneath the matching section of that project's own design document, going deeper, never a new block. Co-production is organic and natural: the work grows from what is already there, the way a living thing does, rather than having new structures built beside it [PUBLIC]. A long piece of my own that belongs to no project → a post in my diary, spine:Phenomemental, written in parts; a short message in the person's pool points to it (confirmed with me 2026-10-11) [PUBLIC]. A project's private working plan → benea

name: her name
